title: phlegmariurus badinianus
intro: Phlegmariurus badinianus, commonly known as the Badinian walking fern, is a species of climbing plant in the family Lycopodiaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to treat respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Phlegmariurus badinianus include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory function, which may also contribute to its use in treating coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of Phlegmariurus badinianus include lycopodine and other alkaloids, which are thought to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
